verdict.rationale: The evidence describes event-triggered workflow starts, CEL-based event filters, and concurrency controls, but nothing documents sending a signal/event/message into an already-running workflow instance from an external API, webhook, or another workflow (e.g., human-in-the-loop pause/resume/approval semantics). This is a plausible and common capability for a workflow orchestration engine, so its absence in the evidence pack is a gap rather than an inapplicable axis.
